title: CrowdWorks: re-login in the dedicated crowdworks-profile (headed, owner logs in) — then confirm dashboard only
detail: Same procedure as crowdworks-profile-init (10/07). The profile showed ログイン/会員登録 at 22:30 JST 10/10. Use ONLY server playwright-crowdworks. (1) browser_navigate https://crowdworks.jp/login, leave the window in front. (2) Never type into ID/password/2FA fields — the owner logs in. If the login form has a 'ログインしたままにする'/'ログイン状態を保持' checkbox, the owner should tick it (the 10/07 session did not persist). (3) One browser_snapshot every ~60 s, no reloads/clicks, up to 45 min, until logged in. (4) Navigate once to https://crowdworks.jp/dashboard and confirm マイページ loads (record URL + title; no personal data). (5) browser_close. Log human minutes (category login). Then mark owner-crowdworks-relogin-profile done too (node scripts/oct/ops.mjs done mac-local owner-crowdworks-relogin-profile --result 'owner re-logged in via crowdworks-profile-relogin'). If 45 min pass with no login: browser_close, release --blocked-by owner-crowdworks-relogin-profile.
acceptance: login confirmed yes/no, dashboard reached, browser closed, human minutes logged
